checks.name: Native failure does not pin a completed registration promise
Permission is rechecked after settings change without repeatedly prompting a denial
Concurrent callers share setup and native registration
Identical callbacks and context do not rewrite the backend association
Latest company wins over an older pending permission check
Transient backend failure retries the cached token
Retries are bounded and foreground permits recovery
Logout revokes its captured account and a late acknowledgement preserves a new login
An offline revocation stays queued and does not block a fresh registration

method: Actual client push service; controlled Capacitor/callable transports and retry clock.
